parsed.name: 是德 DSO-X 数字示波器
parsed.description: 这是一类台式数字存储示波器，用于观察和分析电压随时间变化的波形，并进行常见电学测量。它常用于电子电路调试、信号完整性检查、时序分析以及实验室中的通用波形测量。
parsed.description_en: This is a family of bench digital storage oscilloscopes used to view and analyze voltage waveforms over time and perform common electrical measurements. It is commonly used for electronics debugging, signal integrity checks, timing analysis, and general waveform measurements in the laboratory.

actions.description: 读取示波器当前统计测量窗口中的测量统计结果。
actions.description_en: Read the measurement statistics from the oscilloscope's current statistics display.
